package.description: A quick and easy way to display system info statistics in a CLI with help from LibreHardwareMonitor

en-US.description: A quick and easy way to display system info statistics in a CLI with help from LibreHardwareMonitor
en-US.longDescription: Displays Windows hardware sensor data in a terminal and can optionally transmit sensor readings to a user-configured InfluxDB instance. Some sensors require the CLI to run with administrator privileges.
en-US.name: LibreHardwareMonitorCLI
